title.value: Combined Reinforcement Learning via Abstract Representations
title.justification: The title 'Combined Reinforcement Learning via Abstract Representations' directly reflects the proposed approach outlined in the paper to bridge model-free and model-based reinforcement learning via a shared low-dimensional learned encoding.
title.quote: We present a novel deep RL architecture, which we call CRAR (Combined Reinforcement via Abstract Representations).

analysis.description: This paper presents a novel reinforcement learning (RL) architecture called CRAR (Combined Reinforcement via Abstract Representations), which combines model-free and model-based approaches with a specific focus on an abstract representation that jointly optimizes both components.

type.justification: The paper focuses on implementing and testing the CRAR architecture through various experiments to demonstrate its effectiveness and benefits, which is characteristic of empirical research.
type.quote: In the experimental section, we show for two contrasting domains that the CRAR agent is able to build an interpretable low-dimensional representation of the task and that it can use it for efficient planning.

name.justification: The paper primarily deals with improving reinforcement learning techniques by combining model-free and model-based approaches via an abstract representation.
name.quote: In the quest for efficient and robust reinforcement learning methods, both model-free and model-based approaches offer advantages.

name.justification: The paper introduces a novel deep learning architecture for reinforcement learning and presents experimental results using deep learning techniques.
name.quote: We present a novel deep RL architecture, which we call CRAR (Combined Reinforcement via Abstract Representations).

name.justification: The architecture uses a model-based component to interact with the abstract state representations for planning and estimation.
name.quote: The CRAR agent combines model-based and model-free components.

name.justification: The architecture incorporates model-free components for joint inference along with the model-based parts using a shared abstract representation.
name.quote: In addition, our approach is modular thanks to the explicit learning of the model-based and model-free components.

is_compared.quote: The CRAR architecture can also be used in a meta-learning setting...It is shown in Figure 9 that the CRAR agent is able to achieve better data efficiency.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The CRAR agent is an original contribution of this paper, therefore, it's unlikely to have a separate reference title prior to this work.

name.justification: The experimental section uses a labyrinth environment to test the CRAR agent's ability to learn without rewards.
name.quote: We consider a labyrinth MDP with four actions illustrated in Figure 2.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The Labyrinth task appears to be developed as part of the experimentations within this paper and doesn't reference an external paper.

name.justification: The Catcher environment is described and used to show the CRAR agent's capabilities in another domain with rewards.
name.quote: The catcher environment considered in this paper is made up of balls (blocks of dark pixels) that periodically appear at the top of the frames.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The Catcher environment is presented as part of this paper's experimental design without referencing an external prior work.
